description: One streamed Anthropic message with text and a tool call, traced by OpenLLMetry.
notes: TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content is recorded on spans as gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages. TRACELOOP_METRICS_ENABLED is false. ANTHROPIC_OPEN_TELEMETRY is false, which turns off the Anthropic SDK's own spans. These provider packages have no TRACELOOP_TELEMETRY switch and no vendor export URL; spans go through the harness tracer provider. gen_ai.prompt.N is not written. The mock waits 120 ms before the first chunk and splits the text and the tool arguments into 4 chunks each. Anthropic streams include usage without a separate request flag. Input 40 is copied. The stream starts with output_tokens 1 and ends with the scripted 18, and the instrumentor adds those, so gen_ai.usage.output_tokens is 19. Cache read and cache write are written as 0. Duration is a metric, and metrics are disabled, so the span has no timing attribute.
